turns.content: 2,3-Diphenylbutane-2,3-diol is heated under acidic conditions, and the product shows an intense IR band at 1690 cm^-1. What reaction class should be considered for this vicinal diol?
After protonation and water loss, compare phenyl and methyl migration in the carbocation and identify the favored 1,2-shift and resulting ketone skeleton.
Convert that product skeleton into its systematic IUPAC name.
Track the migrating carbon group and the carbon that becomes the carbonyl center, then verify that the resulting atom map gives the proposed ketone connectivity.
Use the intense 1690 cm^-1 band as a functional-group check. What group does it support, and is it consistent with the proposed pinacol-rearrangement product?
Give the final systematic name and condensed structural description of the major product.
